remarks:
This is a To-Be-Built Home, available in Fieldstream Estates, one of Lancaster's newest communities, the Cambridge blends spacious design with the features today's families value most.

Just off the foyer, a versatile flex room provides the perfect space for a home office, study, playroom, or quiet retreat. Across the hall, the formal dining room creates a dedicated space for gathering with family and friends, while remaining conveniently connected to the kitchen through an optional butler's pantry area that can provide additional storage and entertaining functionality.

The heart of the home is the impressive open-concept living area. A dramatic two-story great room with fireplace creates a bright and welcoming atmosphere, while the kitchen offers an oversized center island, abundant cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, and seating for casual meals and everyday conversation. Whether hosting guests or enjoying a quiet evening at home, the Cambridge is designed to bring people together.

Upstairs, four generously sized bedrooms provide comfort and privacy for everyone. Each bedroom includes its own walk-in closet, offering plenty of storage and organization space. The Primary Suite serves as a private retreat, featuring a spacious bedroom, dual vanities, a private water closet, and a large walk-in closet designed to accommodate every stage of life.

The Cambridge offers approximately 3,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space that balances functionality, comfort, and timeless style for the way families live today.
